empty.title: Not here yet
empty.body: This section arrives in a later version of the app. The command line does all of it today.
services.none: The daemon reports no services yet.
services.no_daemon: There are no services to show while the daemon is not running. Press Start all to start it.
services.heading: Services in the daemon
service.web_stack: Web stack: starts with Start all
sites.heading: Sites
sites.parked_hint: Every folder inside a parked folder is a site. Unparking one stops serving them; your files stay where they are.
sites.none: There are no sites yet. Park a folder with your projects, or link one folder.
link.title: Link a folder as a site
link.name: Site name
link.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens. The folder keeps its place; Crisol only serves it under this name.
settings.terminal_hint: The terminal Crisol opens: with the PHP, Node and npm of Crisol first and the tools of other suites out of the way. The command crisol shell uses it too.
settings.terminal_none: No terminal was found on this computer.
banner.version: The daemon is of another version
banner.reload_error: The last web configuration was not applied
banner.blocked: Crisol is waiting to change the web stack
exit.title: The services keep running
exit.body: Quitting closes this window and the tray icon only. Your sites keep answering. To stop them as well, use Stop all and quit in the tray menu. This notice is shown once.
webview2.title: Crisol needs WebView2
webview2.body: Crisol draws its window with Microsoft Edge WebView2, which is not installed on this computer. Install the Evergreen runtime from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/ and open Crisol again.
